title: My first Mall World Dream in a long time

classification.question_topic: Whether infinite parking-lot/lost dreams are scarier than mall dreams; mentions idea that getting lost indicates stress

meta.final_emotion: unsettled; lost (woke up before next steps)
meta.author_theory: Mentions being told dreams about getting lost indicate stress in real life; wonders if true.

position.relative_to: across the street from a Little Caesar's Pizza joint

qualities.raw_description: At work; went to go on my lunch break; realized I didn't actually CLOCK OUT; went back in to the building and clocked out for lunch.

position.relative_to: right across the street from where my work site was

qualities.raw_description: Intended destination for lunch; right across the street from work.

position.relative_to: appears after clocking out for lunch; between work and the Little Caesar's across the street

qualities.raw_description: Found myself in this massive parking lot that seemed to be growing every second; tried making my way across; the parking lot seemed to grow to unrealistic proportions with each step; felt more like navigating a labyrinth; basically SCP-3008 as a parking lot instead of an IKEA store; eventually got lost; quite unsettling.

connections.qualities: After clocking out for lunch, transitioned to the parking lot.
Attempted to cross the street toward Little Caesar's, but the parking lot expanded with each step and became labyrinth-like; got lost before reaching destination.

boundaries.description: Parking lot expands to unrealistic proportions with each step; navigation becomes labyrinth-like; dreamer cannot reach the intended destination and becomes lost.

interactions.description: Realized they did not clock out for lunch; went back into the building and clocked out.
Tried to walk across the parking lot toward Little Caesar's across the street; the lot grew larger with each step and became like a labyrinth; got lost.
interactions.transaction_blocker: Environment expansion/scale shift: parking lot 'growing every second' and 'with each step'.
